title: The pad prices a catalogue-resolved product by its words: proceed() sends only scannedGtin, so the code a typed search or a barcode lookup wrote to gtin is dropped
comment: DEFECTS row D-034 (2026-09-07), same shape as D-266 C1 (a gtin that is set on one side and not read on the other). Re-breaks the line the fix changed: `item.scannedGtin ?? item.gtin` goes back to `item.scannedGtin`.
ifMissed: A seam test that drives a typed pick through the real client into the real /api/price and asserts the request body carries the picked product's barcode (the crawler's bad-route rule sees only a missing route, not a missing field).
